REGULATION II OF 1997
FRONTIER CRIMES (AMENDMENT) REGULATION, 1997
A Regulation further to amend the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th February, 1997]
No. F.2(3)/97‑Pub, dated 14‑2‑1997.‑‑The
following Regulation made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas, it is expedient
further to amend the Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901 (Regulation III of 1901),
in its application to Federally Administered Tribal Areas;
And whereas clause (5) of Article 247 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan provides that the President
may, with respect to any matter, make regulations for the peace and good
Government of a Federally Administered Tribal Area or any part thereof;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers aforesaid,
the President, pleased to make the following regulation:‑‑
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑‑(1) This
Regulation made called the Frontier Crimes (Amendment) Regulation, 1997.
(2) It extends to the Federally Administered Tribal
Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of section 2, Regulation No.III of 1901.‑‑In
the Front. Crimes Regulation, 1901 (Regulation III of 1901), hereinafter
referred to as t: said Regulation, in section 2,‑‑
(a) for clause (c) the following shall be
substituted, namely:‑‑
"(c) 'Commissioner' in relation to the Federally
Administered Tribal Areas or any part thereof shall mean the Commissioner of
the division to which such area or part thereof is attached for administrative
officer as the Governor may appoint in this behalf and;
(b) after clause (c), amended
as aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(d) 'Governor' means the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province as Agent to the President of Pakistan under Article 145 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan for. Federally
Administered Tribal areas.".
3. Amendment of section 48,
Regulation No.III of 1901.‑‑ In the said regulation, for
section 48 the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"48 Appeal, ‑‑‑An appeal shall lie to the
Commissioner within thirty days from the date of any decision given, decree or
sentence passed, or order made by the Deputy Commissioner under this
Regulation.".
4. . Omission of section 49, Regulation No.III of 1901.‑‑In
the said Regulation, section 49 shall be omitted
5. Amendment of sections 50, 51, 53, 54 and 55, Regulation III of
1901.‑‑In the said Regulation, in sections 50, 51, 53, 54 and
55 for the word 'revisional', wherever occurring the word 'appellate' shall be
substituted
6. Insertion of section 55A to Regulation NO.III of 1901.‑‑In the
said Regulation after section 55 the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:‑‑
"55A. Revision.‑‑(1) Subject
to subsection (2) a revision against any decision given, decree or sentence
passed, or order made by the Commissioner under section 48 shall lie to the
Tribunal consisting of‑‑
(a) Home Secretary, N.‑W.F.P.; and
(b) Law Secretary, N.‑W.F.P.
(2) If the members of the Tribunal shall differ in
opinion, the case shall be referred to Chief Secretary, N.‑W.F.P. and the
case shall be decided according to the opinion of the majority..
